items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lee Konitz said, right after, he’s… “How am I gonna follow that?”

ctx.x: Well, what about the NEA Jazz Master Fellowship? What, when you received that three years ago…
Yeah, that was… that was the same thing. In those… that, that year was Jimmy Cobb. Lee Konitz. The engineer from [inaudible] Van Gelder.
